svg.title: SAP/Warp — thin-disc native parameter sweep
svg.desc: Native parameter sweep summary for the three thin discs gravity-settling benchmark.
svg.text: Three 202-mm × 4-mm analytic discs, 2-s gravity settling; Drake preset in the primary sweep. Shape parameters are shown; equal-material contacts combine to pair parameters.
Low ke fails; high ke is stable but coarse dt can retain tail motion.
B. dt raises peak overlap at a fixed ke
The y axis is capped at 4 mm so escaped low-ke cases do not hide the stable trends.
C. Larger tau reduces peak overlap in this settling trajectory
At ke=1e5, tau=1–30 ms all settle; at ke=1e4, tau=30 ms finally settles.
D. rigid_gap prevents the zero-gap transient in this case
ke=1e5, tau=3 ms, dt=.5 ms. Jitter is multiplied ×100 only for display.
Drake gives lower peak overlap than approx32/64 at ke=1e5–1e6; all three presets remain ordered in this sampled region.
ke=10e3: approx32 2.18 mm / 2 s | approx64 2.18 mm / 2 s | drake 2.08 mm / 2 s
ke=100e3: approx32 0.97 mm / 0.196 s | approx64 0.97 mm / 0.196 s | drake 0.36 mm / 0.170 s
ke=1e6: approx32 0.84 mm / 0.182 s | approx64 0.84 mm / 0.182 s | drake 0.17 mm / 0.167 s
